title: Versioned schemas failed to compile because relative references used URN bases
symptom: Most Phase Zero schemas parsed as JSON but failed real Draft 2020-12 compilation.
impact: Repository validation could report structural success while consumers could not resolve schema references.

root_cause.statement: Schemas used URN identifiers as bases while retaining relative references that had no resolvable URI hierarchy.

solution_options.description: Register every schema in Ajv Draft 2020-12 and use absolute URN references between schemas.
Replace URN identifiers with hierarchical file URLs and keep relative references.

checks: Phase Zero instance and negative tests

prevention: Compile every schema rather than checking JSON syntax only
Keep a negative fixture for malformed review hashes and intake conditions

checks: No credential, personal data, customer identity, raw confidential log, or proprietary payload is present.

requirements: Review the target customer's schema dialect and tooling
